title: A Multibit Sigma–Delta ADC for Multimode Receivers
function_summary: Multibit Sigma–Delta ADC: The DEM algorithm is implemented in such a way as to minimize additional delay within the feedback loop of the modulator, thereby enabling the use of the highest resolution quantizer yet reported in a multibit sigma–delta analog-to-digital converter of this speed.
